messages.content: Hi there, why have you raised to BCFC? The ET is with MRCY. We accepted 02/02 and took back supply so the ET is resolved. Please stop raising.

Hi team, we have initiated an ET on the 7th of January for this MPAN and have been told that your team responded on the 14th of January, but we can not see any response. We have now re-initiated the ET, kindly accept so that we can get the customer back.
